name: Computation Reordering
definition: A technique that reschedules independent operations in a computation to exploit coherence and improve performance by doing as much computation as possible with data currently in memory, delaying computations that need data currently on disk.
summary: Computation reordering reschedules independent rendering operations to prioritize data in fast memory, solving out-of-core bottlenecks by exploiting data coherence while ensuring correctness via Z-buffering.
